urlsChecked.description: Number of URLs fetched and evaluated.

passed.description: Number of evaluated URLs with no error or warning finding.

autoFixable.description: Never emitted since 0.3.0. It described which gate module a finding lived in, not whether applying it unattended was safe -- honouring it would have auto-applied seo.h1.multiple and seo.description.long. Retained here, and only here, so reports written before 0.3.0 still validate against this schema (a finding sets additionalProperties: false). Use fixTier instead.

fixTier.description: The EPISTEMIC axis: what kind of information the correct edit requires. A static property of the finding id. Additive and optional -- a report written before 0.3.0 has no fixTier and still validates.

applicability.description: The SAFETY axis, computed per finding-instance as the minimum of the tier ceiling, the locator's confidence, the edit's blast radius and any protected-surface ceiling. Every input can demote; none can promote. Absent from an `omnirank audit` report, which does no locating.

notEvaluated.description: Gates OmniRank could not actually run, so it does not stay silent about them. Additive/optional: a report generated before v0.2.1 has no notEvaluated key and still validates.

reason.description: Why the gate could not run. Additive: matcher-unsupported and budget-exceeded arrive in 0.4.0, so a report written earlier contains neither and still validates. matcher-unsupported means the check needed a stdlib capability this interpreter lacks (urllib.robotparser is RFC 9309 compliant only on Python 3.14+); OmniRank refuses to judge rather than answer from a matcher it knows is wrong.

url.description: Set for a per-page gate that could not run.

site.description: Set for a site-level gate that could not run.
